::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 5th [1863]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920
:::

[Sir](people/person_939.qmd),

I am sorry you had so much trouble about the <u>[Trial](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd)</u>. I was only waiting to send it to you till I heard whether you thought it worth while to look at it so long before hand. I now send it by this post. There are six more chapters not yet in type of about the length of these, but I hope that the last of them will appear on the 1st of March or April, and I should imagine that the whole had better appear as soon as possible afterwards.

I have arranged that the [Clever Woman of the Family](cmy_books/cmybook_58.qmd)should first come out in the [Churchman’s Family magazine](organizations/other_63.qmd), to be completed there by December 1864,[^1] but I retain the copy right, and shall hope to bring out the book together in December, having stipulated with [Messrs Hogg](organizations/other_159.qmd)[^2] that the choice of a publisher for it shall then be in my hands.

I have not yet had an answer from [Messrs Longman](organizations/other_153.qmd) with regard to my other works

Your obt servt 

C.M. Yonge

A Macmillan Esq

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: It appeared there from Jan 1864 to May 1865. Macmillan published it in 1865.
[^3]: Publishers of the *Churchman’s Family Magazine* from Jan. 1863 to April 1873.
